question: Three of the following letter-clusters are alike in some manner and hence form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- Letters are written in descending order or immediate pervious letter order according to English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• PONM

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3980e6d3019bee558a7c2a7aca78710536709cafffa76f41ea78aeab2ce36ec8.png] 

 
• EDCB

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fde569d3e931a9c72742ad96a7f1315cd6c263aa9ca2beae14289930e377b44c.png] 

 
• SRQP

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ceb629829222988a859cf6d0c842c1e5eaee3495f928c8da14c756387c9f443a.png] 

 
• BYXW

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9370954d8754a7a7ae8b5d5bcbfee2b448d6b7292942c1a0ac9b1becf78083ab.png] 

Thus, out of all options only **'****BYXW**' doesn't follows the same logic as others.

Hence, the correct answer is **"BYXW**".
